title: Task-conditioned Mirror exceptions to C4 equivariance

prior_art.fact: G-CNNs and steerable CNNs tie parameters across group orbits; exact transformed copies are not independent functional multiplicity.
prior_art.mirror_question: Can a small task-conditioned Mirror exception recover useful symmetry breaking while sharing one exact C4-equivariant base, and does it improve the storage/quality frontier over plain low-rank exceptions?

scope: Finite-group linear operator mechanism screen, not a CNN/image benchmark.

group.name: C4
group.equivariant_base: A shared 4x4 circulant matrix, exactly equivariant under all four C4 actions.

teacher.aligned: A shared seeded C4-equivariant circulant base C plus a task residual R(theta_t)B, where B is one seeded 4x4 matrix and R(theta) applies two fixed output Givens planes (0,1) and (2,3).
teacher.independent: A shared seeded C4-equivariant base plus four independent seeded 4x4 residual matrices.
teacher.data: x~Normal(0,I4); independent train/dev/query streams; all task IDs occur in train and audit; evaluate regression MSE, argmax accuracy and equivariance error. Exact C4 copies are evaluated as transforms and never counted as extra learned task functions.

methods.equivariant_only: One shared C4-circulant matrix, no task exception.
methods.mirror_exception: One shared C4-circulant matrix, one shared 4x4 residual matrix, and one learned scalar Givens angle per task.
methods.basis2_exception: One shared C4-circulant matrix plus two unrestricted 4x4 residual bases and two coefficients per task.
methods.independent_maps: Four full task-specific 4x4 maps; independent upper control.
methods.hard_shared_residual: One shared C4-circulant matrix plus one common residual matrix for every task.

training.selection: Select each method's common update count by lowest mean dev MSE pooled over both teacher families, worlds and model seeds; evaluate every 25 updates.
training.audit: Freeze settings and counts before fresh query generation.

metrics.storage: Safetensors packed model inference state with schema/layout metadata charged; identical data-generating teacher state is not part of deployed model.

success_gate: On aligned teacher worlds, Mirror task accuracy within 2 percentage points of independent_maps in at least 2/3 audit worlds and payload <=60% of independent_maps. Report equivariance error and compare basis2_exception; no Mirror-specific claim if the basis control is equally small or better on quality/runtime.
failure_gate: FAIL if aligned accuracy or bytes gate fails in at least 2/3 worlds, or if Mirror misses the accuracy gate against independent_maps in all worlds. Independent-residual worlds map the boundary and are not required to pass.
boundaries: The aligned teacher is constructed from Givens task views and favors Mirror.
C4 finite-dimensional linear operator, not convolutional image classification or a G-CNN reproduction.
No claim that exact group orbit copies add independent capacity.
